title: data_engine
summary: A personal collection of Jupyter notebooks experimenting with synthetic tabular data generation, including a vendored copy of CTGAN and SDV's data-processing source for reference. The notebooks import SDV's single-table synthesizers directly, fitting GaussianCopula, TVAE and CTGAN models and evaluating them with sdv.evaluation.single_table's quality and diagnostic functions.
